mapper.sql: select t.task_id, t.parent_id, t.owner_user_id, t.task_name, t.description, t.status, t.priority, t.progress, t.total_quantity, t.completed_quantity, t.plan_start_date, t.due_date, t.completed_time, t.sort, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, case when t.due_date < curdate() and t.status not in ('2', '3') then 1 else 0 end as overdue, case when exists ( select 1 from task_item c where c.parent_id = t.task_id and c.owner_user_id = t.owner_user_id and c.del_flag = '0' ) then 1 else 0 end as has_children from task_item t
mapper.insert: insert into task_item ( parent_id, owner_user_id, task_name, description, status, priority, progress, total_quantity, completed_quantity, plan_start_date, due_date, completed_time, sort, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{parentId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{taskName}, #{description}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{progress}, #{totalQuantity}, #{completedQuantity}, #{planStartDate}, #{dueDate}, #{completedTime}, #{sort}, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: update task_item set parent_id = #{parentId}, task_name = #{taskName}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, priority = #{priority}, progress = #{progress}, total_quantity = #{totalQuantity}, completed_quantity = #{completedQuantity}, plan_start_date = #{planStartDate}, due_date = #{dueDate}, completed_time = #{completedTime}, sort = #{sort}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where task_id = #{taskId} and owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and del_flag = '0'

update task_item set progress = #{progress}, status = #{status}, completed_time = #{completedTime}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where task_id = #{taskId} and owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(1) as total, coalesce(sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as inProgress, coalesce(sum(case when due_date between curdate() and date_add(curdate(), interval #{upcomingDays} day) and status not in ('2', '3') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as upcoming, coalesce(sum(case when due_date < curdate() and status not in ('2', '3') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as overdue, coalesce(sum(case when status = '2' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as completed from task_item where owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and parent_id = 0 and del_flag = '0'
